purpose: MO v1 visual + NHD High Resolution checks of agency pins (research only; not read by the app). USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages (TNM staged products) are queried locally (HU4 0711, 0714, 0802, 1029, 1030, 1101, 1107).
flowlineService: USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages (NHDFlowline), see research/raw/geo_cache/nhd_hr_gpkg_sources.json and tools/mo_nhd.py
method: Distance = nearest segment of the named-river NHD HR NHDFlowline (HU4 GeoPackage) to the pin, local equirectangular metres. Bank = side of the digitised centreline relative to its flow direction. NHDArea = StreamRiver polygons; pin inside polygon means it plots in the mapped channel.
